mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strong consumer demand, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods with sustained HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over three months signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease by more than 100,000 in a month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three months signals a strengthening consumer economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases over 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% over six months, coupled with a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1%, signals inflationary pressure without sufficient monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 2% in 6 months and FEDFUNDS < 1%
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strong economic growth, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods with sustained GDPC1 increases.
